name: storyteller_style
purpose: Target sound and pacing for Ren, the long-form storyteller. Measurements only: no audio from the reference is stored or cloned.

reference.source: Instagram reel by worldwirevideos, 'Governments Are Saying Get Ready. Here's Why', screen recording sent 3 Nov 2026
reference.note: One narrator throughout: every segment of 1.5 s or more matches the average voiceprint; short clips score lower only because they are short.

voice.character: low-mid, warm, unhurried; wide but smooth pitch movement, no sharp peaks; same tone from the first line to the last

pace.sentence_length: mostly 4 to 14 words; long facts split into two short sentences

writing_habits: opens on a puzzle: 'Okay, so here's something strange.'
plants an open loop early and pays it off late: 'one of them ends with two buckets', 'Hold that thought.'
keeps the viewer close: 'Stick with us.', 'We read every list so you don't have to.'
states one fact per sentence, each with a number, a date or a name
marks its own opinion clearly: 'Here's our take', 'Our honest view is'
calms instead of scaring: 'not your panic. Just your time.', 'capacity means they could. It doesn't mean they will.'
signposts structure: 'Let's start with the map', 'Pressure 1 is space.'
video_habits: 16:9 landscape picture shown in the middle of the vertical feed (the TV-shaped look)
one or two words of caption at a time, white bold capitals, centred low in the picture
data cards with a small label above a big number ('GERMANY SAYS' / '10 DAYS')
a chapter list ('IN THIS VIDEO') early on, ticked off as the story moves
a constant dark map or globe background, so the voice carries the story
